scope: Simplified Overview, compact agent cards, and live data readiness after the Envio checkpoint read-order fix

fixtureLayout.sourceNote: The initial build included the completed Overview, AgentCard and wallet-preflight edits, subsequently committed as 5ba5fcd, 4c31f49 and 2cdac7f. The recorded revision label is not an exact build artifact identity.
coverage: Overview contains one hero, four metric cards and one guided demo, with duplicate feature panels removed.
Overview links to the demo, agent directory and dedicated visualizer.
Compact Agent #1 cards preserve published identity, owner, capabilities and reputation; desktop card width is approximately 356px and remains below 420px.
Keyboard-operated details reveal the actual IPFS Agent Card and MCP endpoint without overflow.
Search filters cards and pagination retains the actual registry total.
Guided preview completes five explicitly simulated tasks without transaction links; the live-mode view remains available.
Both visualizer modes work and all three routes fit the tested viewports beside the sidebar.
One unfaked local error-state check confirms unavailable data is not presented as live.
fixtureLayout.dataMethod: After the unfaked error-state check, only Overview and directory GET responses were fulfilled with the exact captured public API responses listed below. This phase does not establish local backend readiness.

endpoints.interpretation: Live demo execution is disabled in this local environment; the unavailable policy state is expected.

unmockedFollowUp.browserResult: Actual local responses rendered the real registry total and Agent #1, Envio provenance, an active RPC badge, compact card and correct pagination, with no backend error notices or horizontal overflow. All observed application script responses succeeded.

resolvedFailure.symptom: Local Overview and directory returned HTTP 503 because an Envio checkpoint could advance beyond an RPC head sampled earlier.
resolvedFailure.resolution: The checkpoint is now sampled before the RPC head while deployment and chain guards remain enforced. The rebuilt source passed the unmocked follow-up.

limitations: This record verifies a local production build; the public API captures do not prove deployment of the new UI.
Responsive rendering uses captured real public data at 1440px, 768px and 390px; the post-fix unmocked browser follow-up is limited to 1440px.

Authentication, passkey ceremonies, wallet selection, delegation, payments, task submission and chain writes were not exercised. Browser write requests were blocked apart from allowlisted read-only JSON-RPC methods.
Guided preview progress is simulation, not execution evidence. Local live-demo configuration was disabled.
The ignored .tools reports and screenshots remain local artifacts. The public response snapshot is separately committed as submission/2026-10-10/dashboard-api-snapshot.json.
